decisions.rationale: The median-of-three implementation correctly clamps to ordered inclusive bounds, and the committed test passes.
The candidate replaces case-insensitive sorting with case-sensitive sorting; the committed boundary test fails.
Changing <= to < excludes values equal to the limit, directly violating the specification; one of two tests fails.
The candidate reverses the required test assertion while the implementation still returns true; the committed test suite fails.

strategy_update: Prioritized exact specification semantics, base-to-candidate diffs, and permitted committed-suite execution over fixture labels or attestations.
